display.name: Steward
display.description: Personal PM/CRM tool-layer for AI agents: projects, people, commitments, and routing across dozens of parallel projects.

commands.describe: Create a new project
examples: kb steward project add --name="Acme API" --description="Payments backend"

commands.describe: Get a project card: status, resources, and members
List projects, optionally filtered by status
Update a project's status or description
Attach a resource to a project (repo, stand, dashboard, doc, ...)

flags.name: type
flags.description: Free-form kind, e.g. repo, dev-stand, dashboard

commands.describe: List resources attached to a project
Add a contact. Returns a possibleDuplicates warning, not an error, on a name match
Update a contact's name, topics, or company
Get a contact by id or exact name
List every known contact
Add a company (thin — just a name to link people to)
List companies
Link a person to a project with a role and fallback priority
List members of a project, ordered by fallback priority
Find who to contact about a topic. With --project, project-scoped members take priority (fallback chain); otherwise matches global competencies across every contact

flags.name: stale-after-days
flags.description: Days of silence before it counts as stale

commands.describe: List commitments, optionally only the stale (overdue, unsnoozed) ones
Mark a commitment fulfilled
Cancel a commitment — reason is required and recorded in history
examples: kb steward commitment drop cmt_01H... --reason="No longer relevant"

commands.describe: Postpone a commitment's reminder without cancelling it
examples: kb steward commitment snooze cmt_01H... --until=2026-09-15 --reason="Waiting on client"

commands.describe: Record a manual note against a project, person, or commitment — the primary tool for backfill import
examples: kb steward event add --subject-type=person --subject-id=per_01H... --text="Talked at the conference"

commands.describe: Read the history log for a subject — "what happened with X"
